sentences.zh: 陶氏对此感到特别委屈，因为凝固汽油弹只是其业务中非常小的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为它只占其年销售额的百分之零点五。

sentences.en: And Dow was particularly offended by this because napalm was a very small part of its business.
sentences.zh: 然而它却在某种程度上占据了其企业形象的主导地位。

sentences.en: I mean, it accounted, I think, for a half of one percent of its annual sales.
sentences.zh: 所以公司内部进行了一些讨论。

sentences.en: And yet it had sort of come to take over its corporate identity.
sentences.zh: 公司内部和董事会层面就该怎么做、是否停止生产凝固汽油弹进行了一些辩论。

sentences.en: So there was some internal discussion.
sentences.zh: 这有很多原因。

sentences.en: There were some debates within the company and at the board level about what to do, whether to sort of stop manufacturing napalm.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有客户抵制，他们的财务确实受到了打击，而且他们不得不做很多事情来扭转其作为战争贩子的企业声誉。

sentences.en: And there were lots of reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 但他们真正担心的是招聘问题。

sentences.en: I mean, there were customer boycotts, they did take a financial hit, and they had to do a lot to sort of counter their corporate reputation as a warmonger.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时出现了消费者抵制，他们确实遭受了经济损失，而且他们不得不采取很多措施来扭转其作为战争贩子的企业形象。

sentences.en: But what they really worried about was recruiting.
sentences.zh: 但他们真正担心的是招聘问题。

sentences.en: They worried that on these visits to college campuses, they weren't going to get the best people.
sentences.zh: 他们担心在这些大学校园的访问中，他们招不到最优秀的人才。

sentences.en: They weren't going to get the scientists and the engineers who would help them in the years ahead.
sentences.zh: 他们招不到那些能在未来几年为他们提供帮助的科学家和工程师。

sentences.en: And as a result, they would have long-term costs, not just financial, but also in terms of what they were missing out on.
sentences.zh: 结果，他们将面临长期的代价，不仅是经济上的，还有错失良机带来的损失。

sentences.en: The future employee, with moral objections to napalm, who doesn't come work at Dow Chemical and make the next blockbuster product.
sentences.zh: 那些对凝固汽油弹有道德抵触的未来员工，不会来陶氏化学工作，也不会去创造下一个畅销产品。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they decided to kind of stand their ground.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们决定坚持自己的立场。

sentences.en: They said, you know, we have a duty to produce napalm for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，我们有义务为美国政府生产凝固汽油弹。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: It's our patriotic obligation.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的爱国义务。

sentences.en: And we can withstand the controversy.
sentences.zh: 而且我们能够承受这种争议。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Dow Chemical feels like such an extreme case.
sentences.zh: 陶氏化学感觉像是一个极端的例子。

sentences.en: And it feels quite different from what's going on with these tech companies today.
sentences.zh: 而且它与当今这些科技公司所发生的事情感觉大不相同。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对不同。

sentences.en: These are not totally comparable.
sentences.zh: 这些并不完全具有可比性。

sentences.en: I mean, the Vietnam War at this point was extremely unpopular.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，越战在当时是非常不得人心的。

sentences.en: You had these horrific images coming back.
sentences.zh: 当时有那些可怕的画面传回来。

sentences.en: There's no good use for napalm, right?
sentences.zh: 凝固汽油弹没有任何正当用途，对吧？

sentences.en: There's no, like, pro-social, healthy use.
sentences.zh: 它没有什么所谓的社会公益或健康用途。

sentences.en: For napalm, it's a weapon.
sentences.zh: 对于凝固汽油弹来说，它就是一种武器。

sentences.en: Whereas a lot of these technologies, AI, facial recognition, image recognition, augmented reality, these can all be used for very productive and healthy things.
sentences.zh: 而许多这类技术，如人工智能、人脸识别、图像识别、增强现实，它们都可以用于非常有益和健康的事情。

sentences.en: It's only when you put them into a certain context that they can be used for harm.
sentences.zh: 只有当你把它们置于特定的环境中时，它们才会被用于伤害。

sentences.en: And that would seem to be the case for most tech companies, right?
sentences.zh: 对于大多数科技公司来说，情况似乎也是如此，对吧？

sentences.en: They are developing products not explicitly for the military.
sentences.zh: 他们开发产品并非明确是为了军事用途。

sentences.en: They just happen to be used that way.
sentences.zh: 只是碰巧被那样使用了而已。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence, drones, warfare, and Google.
sentences.zh: 人工智能、无人机、战争与谷歌。

sentences.en: It's a mixture that caused an uproar inside the tech giant where the early motto was, don't be evil.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在科技巨头内部引发轩然大波的混合体，而该巨头早期的座右铭是“不作恶”。

sentences.en: There was a big controversy at Google last year about this military contract known as Project
sentences.zh: 去年谷歌内部发生了一场关于这个名为“Maven项目”的军事合同的巨大争议。

sentences.en: Maven.
sentences.zh: Maven。

sentences.en: Google is developing artificial intelligence to analyze drone video data.
sentences.zh: 谷歌正在开发用于分析无人机视频数据的人工智能。

sentences.en: And this was a Defense Department program that basically used AI and sort of image recognition technology to interpret video images.
sentences.zh: 这是一个国防部的项目，基本上是利用人工智能和某种图像识别技术来解读视频图像。

sentences.en: So, you know, the same kind of AI that Google would use in Google Photos or in, you know, its self-driving car unit to sort of recognize images out on the road.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这和谷歌在谷歌相册或其自动驾驶汽车部门中用来识别道路图像的人工智能是同一种。

sentences.en: It would apparently be used as part of a drone program.
sentences.zh: 显然，它将被用作无人机项目的一部分。

sentences.en: Could be used to, you know, for example, improve the targeting of drone strikes to make drone
sentences.zh: 例如，它可以用来提高无人机打击的瞄准精度，使无人机

sentences.en: strikes more accurate, to be able to recognize certain people or certain buildings and be able to direct a drone at that target specifically.
sentences.zh: 打击更准确，能够识别特定的人或特定的建筑物，并能够引导无人机专门针对该目标。

sentences.en: Again, not what Google engineers probably ever thought the technology would be used for.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这可能根本不是谷歌工程师当初认为该技术会被用于的地方。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, they didn't sign up for that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们当初加入时可没签这个协议。

sentences.en: And, you know, some of them didn't even know that this was happening.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们中有些人甚至不知道这件事正在发生。

sentences.en: Thousands of Google workers now protesting Google's involvement in a Pentagon drone program.
sentences.zh: 数千名谷歌员工现在正在抗议谷歌参与五角大楼的无人机项目。

sentences.en: So there was a big uproar.
sentences.zh: 所以当时引起了巨大的骚动。

sentences.en: There was lots of sort of heated internal meetings.
sentences.zh: 内部举行了许多激烈的会议。

sentences.en: At least 10, maybe 12 employees did resign.
sentences.zh: 至少有10名，也许是12名员工辞职了。

sentences.en: Some resignations.
sentences.zh: 一些辞职事件。

sentences.en: Wow, people quit the company over it.
sentences.zh: 哇，人们因为这件事辞职了。

sentences.en: Yeah, people quit the company over it.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们因为这件事辞职了。

sentences.en: Meantime, thousands of Google employees have signed a letter protesting the company's participation in an artificial intelligence project by the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，数千名谷歌员工签署了一封信，抗议该公司参与五角大楼的一项人工智能项目。

sentences.en: There was a petition that was signed by thousands of Google employees.
sentences.zh: 有一份由数千名谷歌员工签署的请愿书。

sentences.en: Quote, we believe that Google should not be in the business of war.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：“我们认为谷歌不应该涉足战争业务。”

sentences.en: Therefore, we ask that Project Maven be canceled.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们要求取消Maven项目。

sentences.en: Calling for the company to not only not enter into this contract, but to stop making tools of weaponry altogether.
sentences.zh: 呼吁公司不仅不要签订这份合同，而且要彻底停止制造武器工具。

sentences.en: And ultimately,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: Tech giant Google will lend a project with the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 科技巨头谷歌将放弃与五角大楼的一个项目。

sentences.en: Google bowed to the pressure.
sentences.zh: 谷歌屈服于压力。

sentences.en: They pulled the contract.
sentences.zh: 他们退出了合同。

sentences.en: They said they wouldn't renew it.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们不会续签。

sentences.en: They put out a statement saying, you know, we'll still work with the military on other projects, but we're not going to manufacture weapons and weapons sort of related technology.
sentences.zh: 他们发表了一份声明说，你知道，我们仍将在其他项目上与军方合作，但我们不会制造武器及相关技术。

sentences.en: And that seemed to sort of quiet the unreSt.
sentences.zh: 这似乎平息了动荡。

sentences.en: I feel like people would be surprised that a huge tech company like Google would back down like that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们会很惊讶，像谷歌这样的大型科技公司竟然会那样退缩。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it does speak to the difference between a conventional sort of contractor like Dow Chemical and these tech companies.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这确实说明了像陶氏化学这样的传统承包商与这些科技公司之间的区别。

sentences.en: I think there are sort of three main differences there.
sentences.zh: 我认为这其中有三个主要区别。

sentences.en: The first is that these companies are beloved.
sentences.zh: 首先，这些公司深受喜爱。

sentences.en: They have loyal followings and they don't want to do anything to upset that.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有忠实的追随者，他们不想做任何让追随者不高兴的事情。

sentences.en: The second is that these companies are very idealistic.
sentences.zh: 其次，这些公司非常理想主义。

sentences.en: And in Silicon Valley, this is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 在硅谷，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: Companies market themselves not just as profitable enterprises, but as sort of humanitarian projects.
sentences.zh: 公司不仅将自己营销为盈利企业，还营销为某种人道主义项目。

sentences.en: And anything that kind of compromises that hurts them.
sentences.zh: 任何损害这一点的事情都会伤害到他们。

sentences.en: Right, kind of world changers.
sentences.zh: 没错，某种改变世界的人。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And I think the biggest difference is that employees at these companies, especially the engineers who work on very specialized projects like AI development,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为最大的区别在于，这些公司的员工，特别是那些从事人工智能开发等高度专业化项目的工程师，

sentences.en: have a ton of leverage because there are not very many of them.
sentences.zh: 拥有巨大的筹码，因为他们的人数并不多。

sentences.en: They make a ton of money and they're really hard to recruit.
sentences.zh: 他们赚很多钱，而且真的很难招募。

sentences.en: If a couple of chemical engineers walk out of Dow Chemical and protest, you know, they can probably find some more where that came from.
sentences.zh: 如果几个化学工程师走出陶氏化学进行抗议，你知道，他们可能还能找到其他人来填补空缺。

sentences.en: But if hundreds or thousands of AI engineers are upset about a project that Google is working on, that's a real threat to their business.
sentences.zh: 但如果成百上千名人工智能工程师对谷歌正在进行的项目感到不满，那对他们的业务来说就是真正的威胁。

sentences.en: It doesn't take many people staging a protest or threatening to walk out to really get the attention of senior leadership.
sentences.zh: 不需要太多人组织抗议或威胁罢工，就能真正引起高层领导的注意。

sentences.en: So these three differences that you just laid out explain why Dow didn't back down despite images of dying children affected by their products.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才列出的这三个区别解释了为什么陶氏化学尽管有受其产品影响的垂死儿童的照片，却依然没有退缩。

sentences.en: Whereas Google did back down long, long before anything like that happened to it.
sentences.zh: 而谷歌却在类似的事情发生之前很久就退缩了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I want to be clear, like, what happened to Google was the exception, not the rule.
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点，谷歌发生的事情是个例外，而不是常态。

sentences.en: This is not happening, you know, in any vast quantity across the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这并不是在整个科技行业大规模发生的。

sentences.en: At Microsoft, for example, they came right out and said, you know, we appreciate the objections of, you know, this small group of employees.
sentences.zh: 以微软为例，他们直接站出来说，你知道，我们感谢这一小部分员工提出的反对意见。

sentences.en: You know, they can move elsewhere in the company if they want, but we're committed to seeing this contract through.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果他们愿意，他们可以调到公司其他部门，但我们致力于完成这份合同。

sentences.en: And they've sort of defended themselves by saying, we have a patriotic duty to provide technology to the military.
sentences.zh: 他们通过说“我们有爱国义务为军方提供技术”来为自己辩护。

sentences.en: We think that we can sort of advocate for the ethical use of technologies like AI if we're at the table in these discussions.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，如果我们参与这些讨论，我们可以在某种程度上倡导人工智能等技术的道德使用。

sentences.en: And they say that, you know, basically these technologies could be good.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，基本上这些技术可能是好的。

sentences.en: These could save lives on the battlefield if you have, you know, the Army has said it wants to use HoloLens not just for combat training,
sentences.zh: 这些技术可以挽救战场上的生命，如果你有，你知道，陆军已经表示它想使用HoloLens，不仅是为了战斗训练，

sentences.en: but for things like, you know, measuring vital signs and monitoring soldiers for concussions and having some sort of hearing protection on people's ears.
sentences.zh: 而且是为了测量生命体征、监测士兵脑震荡以及在人们耳朵上佩戴某种听力保护装置等事情。

sentences.en: So those are the kinds of arguments they're making to justify staying in these contracts.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是他们用来证明继续履行这些合同合理性的论点。

sentences.en: So the argument here being that engineers who came to these companies to do good, having their technology used by the military does not necessarily mean not doing good.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的论点是，那些来到这些公司是为了做好事的工程师，他们的技术被军方使用并不一定意味着不是在做好事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's one of the arguments that they're making is that basically if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，他们提出的论点之一是，基本上如果美国

sentences.en: military doesn't have the best technology available on the market, our adversaries will, and we will be endangered as a result.
sentences.zh: 军方没有市场上最好的技术，我们的对手就会有，结果我们就会陷入危险。

sentences.en: I guess the question is, do the engineers buy that argument?
sentences.zh: 我想问题是，工程师们买账这个论点吗？

sentences.en: Well, some of them probably do, but as we've seen, a number of them don't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们中有些人可能买账，但正如我们所见，其中许多人并不买账。

sentences.en: So, Kevin, we started by talking about this intersection of the moral and the financial as these tech companies navigate this question of should they work with the military.
sentences.zh: 所以，凯文，我们从讨论道德与财务的交集开始，因为这些科技公司在处理是否应该与军方合作的问题。

sentences.en: What's your understanding in Silicon Valley about how these companies are thinking about that?
sentences.zh: 在硅谷，你对这些公司如何看待这个问题有什么了解？

sentences.en: So I think a lot of these companies have really shifted their view on this in the last couple of years.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为许多这些公司在过去几年里确实改变了对此的看法。

sentences.en: A lot of Silicon Valley companies used to just think of themselves as toolmakers, right?
sentences.zh: 许多硅谷公司过去只是把自己看作工具制造商，对吧？

sentences.en: We build the stuff and we put it out into the world and people use it.
sentences.zh: 我们制造东西，然后把它推向世界，人们使用它。

sentences.en: And our responsibility basically stops at the moment of sale.
sentences.zh: 我们的责任基本上在销售的那一刻就结束了。

sentences.en: To me, entrepreneurship is about creating change, not just creating companies.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，创业是为了创造变革，而不仅仅是创建公司。

sentences.en: And now I think we're seeing that these companies are being held responsible by the public and by their own employees, not just for the tools they're building,
sentences.zh: 现在我认为我们看到这些公司正被公众和他们自己的员工追究责任，不仅仅是因为他们制造的工具，

sentences.en: but for how they're being used in the world.
sentences.zh: 还因为这些工具在世界上是如何被使用的。

sentences.en: And this is not just about the military.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是关于军方。

sentences.en: At this hour, some 300 programmers are threatening to leave Microsoft unless the tech giant drops its contract with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，约有300名程序员威胁要离开微软，除非这家科技巨头放弃与美国

sentences.en: Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency known as ICE.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局（即ICE）的合同。

sentences.en: I mean, it's also companies are being scrutinized for working with ICE or working with law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，公司因与ICE或执法部门合作而受到审查的情况也越来越多。

sentences.en: An Amazon worker is pushing the company to stop selling facial recognition technology to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 一名亚马逊员工正在推动公司停止向执法部门出售人脸识别技术。

sentences.en: Social media companies are being held responsible for bad things that happen on their platforMs.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体公司正因其平台上发生的坏事而被追究责任。

sentences.en: Facebook defending Alex Jones this morning, saying the platform will continue to allow the video blogger to run video on its site even as it claims to crack down on fake news.
sentences.zh: Facebook今天早上为亚历克斯·琼斯辩护，称该平台将继续允许这位视频博主在其网站上发布视频，尽管它声称要打击假新闻。

sentences.en: This is really happening across technology.
sentences.zh: 这确实正在整个科技界发生。

sentences.en: And as technology embeds itself into kind of every part of our lives, we're seeing that these companies are having to make new kinds of decisions.
sentences.zh: 随着技术融入我们生活的方方面面，我们看到这些公司不得不做出新的决策。

sentences.en: It's not just a dollars and cents profit and loss calculation anymore.
sentences.zh: 这不再仅仅是美元和美分的损益计算了。

sentences.en: They also have to consider what might happen out in the world once they release these technologies.
sentences.zh: 他们还必须考虑一旦发布这些技术，世界上可能会发生什么。

sentences.en: Which is another way of saying that the morality element of this is now playing a much bigger role than it has in the past
sentences.zh: 这换句话说就是，其中的道德因素现在发挥的作用比过去大得多，

sentences.en: and perhaps is not beating out financial, but rivaling it?
sentences.zh: 也许不是超过了财务，但正在与之抗衡？

sentences.en: It's certainly part of the discussion now in a way it hasn't been before.
sentences.zh: 它当然是现在讨论的一部分，以一种以前从未有过的方式。

sentences.en: It's not just about how much money we'll make or how many resources it will take.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于我们将赚多少钱或需要多少资源。

sentences.en: It's about what we're building and why we're building it and who we're selling it to.
sentences.zh: 这是关于我们在制造什么，为什么制造它，以及我们要把它卖给谁。

sentences.en: Kevin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 凯文，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The system is well beyond capacity and remains at a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 该系统早已超负荷，并处于崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Trump administration said that the number of migrant families crossing the Mexican
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普政府表示，跨越墨西哥

sentences.en: border has broken records for the fourth time in five months and risks overwhelming government staff and facilities.
sentences.zh: 边境的移民家庭数量在五个月内第四次打破纪录，并有使政府工作人员和设施不堪重负的风险。

sentences.en: Based on the experiences of men and women on the front line, this is clearly both a border security and humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 根据前线男女的经历，这显然既是边境安全危机，也是人道主义危机。

sentences.en: During a news conference, the Commissioner of Customs and Border Protection,
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，海关及边境保护局局长，

sentences.en: Kevin McAleenan, said that more than 76,000 migrants crossed the border without authorization in February, more than double the levels from the same period last year.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡利南表示，2月份有超过76,000名移民未经授权越过边境，是去年同期水平的两倍多。

sentences.en: Within these numbers, we are confronting challenging new smuggling cycles, patterns, and methods.
sentences.zh: 在这些数字中，我们正面临着具有挑战性的新走私周期、模式和方法。

sentences.en: So-called caravans, where 500 or more migrants form groups in Central America, mostly in Honduras, and travel together through Mexico to our southwest border.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“大篷车”，即500名或更多的移民在中美洲（主要是洪都拉斯）组成团体，一起穿过墨西哥到达我们的西南边境。

sentences.en: The record numbers are likely to complicate the already partisan debate between Republicans and Democrats
sentences.zh: 这些创纪录的数字可能会使共和党和民主党之间本已党派化的辩论变得更加复杂，

sentences.en: over the president's plan to build a border wall by declaring a national emergency.
sentences.zh: 即关于总统通过宣布国家紧急状态来建造边境墙的计划。

sentences.en: And for just the second time since the AIDS epidemic began, a patient appears to have been cured of HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, confirming that a cure is possible.
sentences.zh: 而且自艾滋病流行开始以来，第二次有患者似乎被治愈了艾滋病毒（导致艾滋病的病毒），证实了治愈是可能的。

sentences.en: The elimination of the virus in the patient, an anonymous man in London, came after a stem cell transplant, which was intended to treat his blood cancer,
sentences.zh: 这名伦敦匿名男患者体内的病毒被清除，是在进行干细胞移植后实现的，该移植本意是治疗他的血癌，

sentences.en: also removed the HIV virus.
sentences.zh: 同时也清除了艾滋病毒。

sentences.en: It was the same procedure that seemed to cure a different HIV patient 12 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这与12年前似乎治愈了另一名艾滋病患者的程序相同。

sentences.en: We waited 16 months before stopping in the post-transplant period just to make sure that the cancer was in remission, the patient was well,
sentences.zh: 我们在移植后等待了16个月才停止治疗，只是为了确保癌症处于缓解期，患者身体状况良好，

sentences.en: and that the measures we had of the HIV reservoir in the body showed that there was very, very little virus there, if any at all.
sentences.zh: 并且我们对体内艾滋病毒库的测量显示，病毒含量极低，甚至几乎检测不到。

sentences.en: And at that point, we stopped the treatment.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，我们停止了治疗。

sentences.en: How a stem cell transplant could translate into a broader cure for HIV remains unclear, since the treatment used for the London patient
sentences.zh: 干细胞移植如何转化为更广泛的艾滋病治愈方法尚不清楚，因为用于伦敦患者的治疗方法

sentences.en: can only be applied to those with both cancer and HIV.
sentences.zh: 只能应用于那些同时患有癌症和艾滋病的人。

sentences.en: But several teams of scientists are working on gene therapies that could someday be applied to anyone with HIV.
sentences.zh: 但有几个科学家团队正在研究基因疗法，未来或许能应用于所有艾滋病病毒感染者。

sentences.en: And so we're now 18 months in, and we're confident that this will be a long-term remission, but it's too early to say as to whether this is a cure or not.
sentences.zh: 目前已经过去18个月了，我们有信心这会是长期缓解，但现在断言这是否属于治愈还为时过早。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我将与莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
